source: Hidalgo County, Texas — voting precincts from the Texas Legislative Council 2026 precinct map (Precincts26P, the county’s precincts as adopted Dec 16, 2025), split where a precinct has more than one ballot by the county City Limits 2025 layer, the City of Weslaco’s city limits and single-member commission districts, and Texas Education Agency School Districts SY2025-26; precinct and sub-precinct ballot styles from the county’s Ballot Style Legend
note: Each polygon is a precinct, or the part of a precinct that gets one of its printed ballot styles. Thin edge slivers where the boundary layers do not line up exactly (no county address points in any of them) show the races on every ballot in the county and the official sample ballot link. Smallest first.
